title: Sesamum indicum essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Sesamum indicum essential oil is a volatile oil derived from the seeds of the sesame plant through steam distillation. It is valued in herbalism for its warming, stimulating, and anti-inflammatory properties. This essential oil is commonly used to support digestive health, relieve muscle pain, and promote skin healing. It may also be used in aromatherapy to enhance mental clarity and reduce stress. In traditional medicine, it has been employed to treat respiratory and skin conditions.
